rating_definitions.substantial: Direct primary records independently checked, interpretive narrative substantiated, site conditions and relevant rights verified.
rating_definitions.developing: Specific historical assertion with source locator, but primary original or independent corroboration remains incomplete.
rating_definitions.sparse: Named claim exists but precise boundaries, firsthand record, physical survival or contradiction needs verification.
rating_definitions.missing: Necessary evidence, rights or access unavailable for an explanatory visitor-ready account.
